data.credibility: Management guides ambitious long-term goals like $2B by FY27 and $5B by FY31, but these targets frequently disappear from subsequent call mentions. However, concrete short-term guidance such as the FY26 tax rate was successfully delivered.

lines.line: Aspired to reach $2 billion by end of FY27, but topic was dropped.
Aspired to reach $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31; currently on track.
Guided FY26 effective tax rate of 20% to 24%; delivered 22.6%.

bull: Revenue compounded at 28.6% and net profit at 32.8% annually over five years.
Strong capital efficiency with a 27.2% ROE, 34.4% ROCE, and low debt-to-equity of 0.07.
Operating cash flow reached 101% of reported profit over the last five years.
bear: Growth is slowing down, dropping to 20.9% over three years compared to 28.6% over five.
Working-capital days doubled from 25 to 50 days over the last five years.
Borrowings increased significantly from ₹98 cr in FY21 to ₹575 cr in TTM.
